title: SiST-GNN: Simultaneous Spatial-Temporal Message Passing for Dynamic Graph Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.25548v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dynamic graph neural networks (DGNNs) that operate on snapshot sequences typically fall into one of two categories. \emph{Temporal-first} approaches build per-node temporal embeddings and only afterward perform spatial aggregation, whereas \emph{Spatial-first} approaches invert this order, feeding the output of a graph convolution into a downstream temporal module. In either case, the rigid sequencing forces the second stage to consume an already-compressed summary produced by the first, ruling out joint reasoning over topology and evolution; effectively, the message-passing operator never gets to weight a neighbor's contribution by that neighbor's \emph{past} trajectory. This paper introduces \textbf{SiST-GNN} (\textbf{Si}multaneous \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{GNN}), which fuses the two signals inside a single message-passing operation rather than chaining them. translated_title: SiST-GNN：面向动态图表示学习的同步时空消息传递
translated_abstract: 基于快照序列的动态图神经网络（DGNN）通常分为两类。“时间优先”方法先为每个节点构建时间嵌入，之后再进行空间聚合；而“空间优先”方法则颠倒这一顺序，将图卷积的输出送入下游的时间模块。无论哪种情况，这种刚性的先后顺序都迫使第二阶段只能消费第一阶段已经压缩的摘要信息，从而无法对图拓扑与演化过程进行联合推理；实际上，消息传递算子永远无法根据邻居的“过去”轨迹来衡量该邻居的贡献。本文提出了SiST-GNN（同步时空图神经网络），它在单一的消息传递操作中融合这两种信号，而非将它们串联起来。在每个快照处，我们维护一个循环隐藏状态……
tldr: SiST-GNN提出在单一消息传递操作中同时融合空间与时间信息，突破了传统动态图神经网络“时间优先”或“空间优先”的串行处理局限，实现了对图拓扑结构与演化过程的联合推理。
en_tdlr: SiST-GNN fuses spatial and temporal signals within a single message-passing operation, overcoming the rigid sequential design of temporal-first or spatial-first dynamic GNNs and enabling joint reasoning over graph topology and its evolution.
